name: Analysis panel contains no more than five paragraphs
description: The analysis content should not exceed five paragraphs to stay focused and avoid bloating the match detail page.

planSteps.description: Click on any bracket cell to open a match detail page
Click the Analysis tab or section control
Scroll through the entire analysis panel to see all text
Verify the analysis panel contains at most 5 distinct paragraph blocks. If more than 5 paragraph blocks are visible, the test fails.
